The Habit tracker's app now uses green instead of orange. That covers the filled checkmarks, the filled squares in the history grid, the streak counts, the "done today" count and the outline on today's column. I used a slightly lighter green in dark mode so the text stays readable.

I also raised the tiny day-of-week letters above the history grid from 10 px to 12 px, because the app check flagged them as too small. The check now passes. Your note's text and data are unchanged.
